opinions: MAKING PEACE WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT CAN REFLECT PRAGMATIC MATURITY, BUT BLIND CONFORMITY TO UNJUST SYSTEMS IS NOT MATURITY.
ECONOMIC GLOBALISATION SHOULD PRIMARILY SERVE HUMAN FLOURISHING AND DIGNITY RATHER THAN THE UNCHECKED POWER OF TRANSNATIONAL CORPORATIONS.
NO RACE HAS SUPERIOR INHERENT QUALITIES TO OTHERS; ALL HUMAN BEINGS POSSESS EQUAL MORAL WORTH AND POTENTIAL.
IN MOST DEVELOPED COUNTRIES THE RICH ARE NOT TAXED AT EXCESSIVE RATES RELATIVE TO THE SOCIAL NEEDS AND INEQUALITY WE FACE.
CHARITY IS ADMIRABLE BUT CANNOT REPLACE THE JUSTICE AND RELIABILITY OF A PROPERLY DESIGNED SOCIAL SECURITY SYSTEM.
CIVIL LIBERTIES HAVE BEEN EXCESSIVELY ERODED IN MANY COUNTRIES UNDER THE BANNER OF COUNTER-TERRORISM, OFTEN WITH DIMINISHING RETURNS ON SECURITY.
CORPORATIONS HAVE BROADER SOCIAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL RESPONSIBILITIES BEYOND MERELY MAXIMISING SHAREHOLDER PROFIT.
SOME PEOPLE ARE INDEED BORN INTO CONDITIONS OF MISFORTUNE THAT CAN REASONABLY BE DESCRIBED AS BAD LUCK.
WHILE CULTURES DIFFER, SOME CULTURAL PRACTICES ARE OBJECTIVELY MORE HUMANE AND CONDUCIVE TO HUMAN FLOURISHING THAN OTHERS.
ACCESS TO HIGH-QUALITY HEALTHCARE SHOULD NOT BE DETERMINED PRIMARILY BY ABILITY TO PAY; A JUST SOCIETY ENSURES DECENT CARE FOR ALL.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE OPEN TO SCRUTINY AND JUSTIFIED; UNQUESTIONED AUTHORITY INEVITABLY LEADS TO ABUSE.
MARKET FREEDOM AND PERSONAL FREEDOM ARE RELATED BUT NOT IDENTICAL; UNREGULATED MARKETS CAN UNDERMINE THE REAL FREEDOM OF MANY PEOPLE.
ABSTRACT ART CAN BE GENUINE ART; AESTHETIC VALUE IS NOT LIMITED TO LITERAL REPRESENTATION.
I WOULD NOT SUPPORT MY COUNTRY WHEN IT IS CLEARLY IN THE WRONG; PATRIOTISM DOES NOT EXCUSE IMMORALITY.
CORPORATIONS REQUIRE ROBUST REGULATION TO PROTECT THE ENVIRONMENT BECAUSE VOLUNTARY SELF-RESTRAINT IS UNRELIABLE.
IT IS NATURAL AND HEALTHY FOR CHILDREN TO MAINTAIN SOME PRIVACY AND SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS.
MASS SURVEILLANCE IN THE ELECTRONIC AGE THREATENS EVERYONE’S PRIVACY AND AUTONOMY, NOT ONLY THOSE WHO HAVE DONE WRONG.
GOVERNMENTS HAVE A DUTY TO PENALISE BUSINESSES THAT DELIBERATELY MISLEAD THE PUBLIC.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGALLY AVAILABLE, ESPECIALLY IN THE EARLY STAGES OF PREGNANCY.
STABLE, LOVING SAME-SEX COUPLES SHOULD BE FULLY ELIGIBLE TO ADOPT CHILDREN.
A GENUINE FREE MARKET DOES REQUIRE RULES THAT PREVENT MONOPOLIES AND PREDATORY CORPORATE BEHAVIOUR.
PUBLIC FUNDING FOR INDEPENDENT BROADCASTING INSTITUTIONS LIKE THE BBC CAN SERVE THE PUBLIC INTEREST AND SHOULD EXIST.
WHEN TROUBLED, CONFRONTING AND PROCESSING EMOTIONS IS GENERALLY HEALTHIER THAN MERE DISTRACTION.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT INHERENTLY IMMORAL WHEN PRACTICED RESPONSIBLY AND CONSENSUALLY.
OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS BROUGHT IMPORTANT GAINS IN KNOWLEDGE AND FREEDOM, THOUGH SOME CULTURAL EXCESS EXISTS.
WE MUST TAKE SERIOUSLY THE WARNINGS OF CLIMATE SCIENCE AND MOVE BEYOND THE ASSUMPTION THAT ENDLESS ECONOMIC GROWTH IS DESIRABLE.
RETRIBUTIVE JUSTICE EXPRESSED AS ‘AN EYE FOR AN EYE’ IS MORALLY PRIMITIVE AND SHOULD BE REJECTED IN FAVOUR OF PROPORTIONATE, HUMANE RESPONSES.
NO ONE SHOULD BE PROHIBITED FROM REPRODUCING ON THE BASIS OF GENETIC CONDITIONS; THAT IS EUGENICS AND INCOMPATIBLE WITH HUMAN DIGNITY.
CLASS DIVISIONS OFTEN CUT DEEPER AND ARE MORE POLITICALLY DECISIVE THAN NATIONAL ONES.
EDUCATION SHOULD DEVELOP CRITICAL THINKING, CHARACTER, AND CIVIC VIRTUE AS WELL AS PREPARE YOUNG PEOPLE FOR EMPLOYMENT.
WHAT CONSENTING ADULTS DO IN PRIVATE IS NONE OF THE STATE’S BUSINESS.
SCHOOLS SHOULD NOT INDOCTRINATE CHILDREN WITH RELIGIOUS VALUES; EDUCATION SHOULD REMAIN SECULAR AND CRITICAL.
IT IS INDEED FOOLISH TO FEEL PERSONAL PRIDE IN THE COUNTRY OF ONE’S BIRTH SINCE NO ONE CHOOSES IT.
CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT AND ENSURING BROAD OPPORTUNITY IS AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT AS CONTROLLING INFLATION.
WHILE PEOPLE HAVE RIGHTS, ENCOURAGING SEPARATION BY IDENTITY OR ETHNICITY IS DIVISIVE AND WRONG.
THE COMMODIFICATION OF SOMETHING AS ESSENTIAL AS DRINKING WATER IS INDEED A SAD REFLECTION ON MODERN CONSUMER SOCIETY.
PHYSICAL PUNISHMENT OF CHILDREN IS UNNECESSARY AND RISKS TEACHING THAT VIOLENCE IS AN ACCEPTABLE PROBLEM-SOLVING METHOD.
IT IS NEVER A COMPLETE WASTE OF TIME TO ATTEMPT REHABILITATION; GIVING UP ON ALL SERIOUS CRIMINALS ABANDONS BOTH JUSTICE AND HOPE.
LAND SHOULD NOT BE TREATED AS AN ORDINARY COMMODITY; ITS OWNERSHIP CARRIES SPECIAL SOCIAL AND ECOLOGICAL RESPONSIBILITIES.
MORALITY DOES NOT REQUIRE RELIGIOUS BELIEF; SECULAR ETHICS ARE ENTIRELY POSSIBLE AND OFTEN ROBUST.
A HEALTHY SOCIETY VALUES EQUALITY, MUTUAL RESPECT, AND ACCOUNTABILITY FAR MORE THAN RIGID HIERARCHIES OF COMMAND AND OBEDIENCE.
FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN AND FREQUENTLY DO BECOME FULLY INTEGRATED MEMBERS OF THEIR NEW SOCIETY.
MOTHERS AND FATHERS BOTH HAVE THE RIGHT TO PURSUE CAREERS; THERE IS NO INHERENT ‘FIRST DUTY’ FOR WOMEN TO BE HOMEMAKERS.
THOSE WHO CAN WORK BUT REFUSE REASONABLE OPPORTUNITIES SHOULD NOT BE INDEFINITELY SUPPORTED BY SOCIETY.
ASTROLOGY HAS NO SCIENTIFIC BASIS AND DOES NOT ACCURATELY EXPLAIN ANYTHING MEANINGFUL.
THE PRINCIPLE ‘FROM EACH ACCORDING TO ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO NEED’ CAPTURES AN IMPORTANT MORAL INTUITION EVEN IF ITS LITERAL IMPLEMENTATION IS DIFFICULT.
THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY MY FRIEND; MORAL JUDGMENT MUST REMAIN INDEPENDENT OF TACTICAL CONVENIENCE.
PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR ADULT CONSUMPTION.
THE DEATH PENALTY IS INCOMPATIBLE WITH RESPECT FOR HUMAN DIGNITY AND SHOULD BE ABOLISHED.
WHAT BENEFITS THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS OFTEN NOT ULTIMATELY GOOD FOR SOCIETY AS A WHOLE.
THE MOST IMPORTANT THINGS FOR CHILDREN TO LEARN ARE CRITICAL THINKING, EMPATHY, CREATIVITY, AND MORAL REASONING, NOT PRIMARILY BLIND ACCEPTANCE OF DISCIPLINE.
STRATEGIC PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO PROTECT VITAL INDUSTRIES AND WORKERS DURING TRANSITIONS.
TAXPAYERS CAN LEGITIMATELY SUPPORT THEATRES, MUSEUMS, AND ARTS INSTITUTIONS THAT PROVIDE PUBLIC CULTURAL GOODS BEYOND COMMERCIAL VIABILITY.
THE FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT HAS INDEED DEGRADED PUBLIC DISCOURSE AND IS WORRYING.
SCHOOLS SHOULD MAINTAIN COMPULSORY ATTENDANCE TO ENSURE EDUCATION FOR ALL, WHILE IMPROVING THE QUALITY THAT MAKES ATTENDANCE WORTHWHILE.
MILITARY ACTION THAT DEFIES INTERNATIONAL LAW IS RARELY JUSTIFIED AND SETS DANGEROUS PRECEDENTS.
HOMOSEXUALITY IS A NATURAL VARIATION OF HUMAN SEXUALITY; PEOPLE DO NOT CHOOSE THEIR FUNDAMENTAL ORIENTATION.
IT IS INDEED REGRETTABLE WHEN VAST FORTUNES ARE ACCUMULATED THROUGH PURE FINANCIAL MANIPULATION WITHOUT CREATING SOCIAL VALUE.
IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE, REHABILITATION SHOULD GENERALLY TAKE PRIORITY OVER PURE PUNISHMENT WHERE IT IS POSSIBLE.
POSSESSING SMALL AMOUNTS OF MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENCE.
WRITERS, ARTISTS, AND CREATORS ARE AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT TO A FLOURISHING SOCIETY AS BUSINESSPEOPLE AND MANUFACTURERS.
THE ARGUMENT THAT A ONE-PARTY STATE AVOIDS DELAY IS VASTLY OUTWEIGHED BY ITS TENDENCY TOWARD CORRUPTION, OPPRESSION, AND CATASTROPHIC POLICY ERRORS.
